child-teen-nutrition.label: Child & Teen Nutrition
child-teen-nutrition.description: From picky eaters and underweight toddlers to teenagers navigating growth, hormones, and school demands, we build nutrition plans that work with Indian food, real family schedules, and the way children actually eat.

adhd-nutrition.label: ADHD Nutrition for Children
adhd-nutrition.description: Personalised, root-cause nutrition support for children and teens with ADHD, designed around adequate nourishment, gut health, appetite, school routines, and Indian food habits.

diabetes.label: Diabetes Nutrition
diabetes.description: Personalised diabetes nutrition that fits Indian food, real routines and everyday life

pcos.label: PCOS Nutrition
pcos.description: Hormone-friendly eating for PCOS, built around your food habits and everyday routines.
intro: PCOS nutrition support is an additional area of care offered by Pragmatic Nutrition.
Your health history, food habits, lifestyle and relevant health data help shape an individual nutrition plan.

sections.title: A personalised approach
paragraphs: Your plan is built around your health history, food habits, lifestyle and relevant health data. Rather than prescribing the same meal plan to everyone with diabetes, the strategy can evolve as your needs change.
This allows nutrition recommendations to become more practical and sustainable over time.

sections.title: Nutrition and metabolic health
paragraphs: Metabolic health is not one condition. It is the foundation that connects blood sugar control, hormonal balance, lipid levels, digestion, and body composition.
Weight changes are addressed as a result of improved metabolic function, not through restrictive or short-term dieting.

sections.title: Work with Meenu Balaji
paragraphs: Meenu Balaji, Founder & Chief Nutritionist, Pragmatic Nutrition, brings more than 14 years of nutrition practice to personalised nutrition care. Credentials and experience include:
Peer Reviewer, European Journal of Nutrition since 2017
Harvard Medical School CME in Lifestyle Medicine
Experience working with clients in India and internationally
Her approach combines evidence-based nutrition with the practical realities of Indian food, family life, work and long-term adherence.

weight-loss.label: Weight Loss
weight-loss.description: Sustainable weight management without crash diets.
intro: Practical nutrition support for people aiming for sustainable weight loss and better overall health.
Food preferences, cultural eating habits, daily routines and weight goals are considered when developing your nutrition strategy.
